text:
sara: Heads-up: kicking off staggered deploy v4.0.0 -> canary (global) in 5m. Focus on embeddings and rerank routes. Please eyeball SLO dash and tenant-specific spikes.
deploy-bot: started rollout: release=v4.0.0 stage=canary strategy=staggered initial=1% user=sara
tom: watching p95/5xx on embed.* and rerank.*. if any tenant gets >0.6% 5xx for 2m, we should consider targeted pinning.
anita: noted. preflight good. setting up synthetic shoppers for common traffic shapes.
observability-bot: alert: embeddings.rerank p95 increased to 420ms (threshold 350ms) for tenant=AcmeCorp region=us-west over 2m. rule=tenant-p95-sentinel
sara: interesting, it's only AcmeCorp. Can we route that tenant to prior version rather than full rollback?
tom: yes - we support tenant-level routing. I'll run: `routectl set-tenant-route --tenant AcmeCorp --service embeddings.rerank --version v3.9.8 --region us-west`
deploy-bot: action: tenant_route_changed tenant=AcmeCorp service=embeddings.rerank old=v4.0.0 new=v3.9.8 by=tom  success
anita: after pin, p95 for AcmeCorp dropped to 200ms within 90s. global SLO unaffected. grabbing heap traces from canary pods for the offending path.
observability-bot: info: 5xx for AcmeCorp fell to baseline 0.05%. overall embed.rerank p95 normalized.
product-bot: FYI: I'll add a customer-facing note for AcmeCorp that we detected a perf regression and temporarily routed them to a stable version while we fix.
sara: thanks. plan: 1) keep v4.0.0 paused for embed.rerank 2) collect traces/logs for AcmeCorp 3) create small perf-fix branch and run canary for that tenant only at 0.5% with synthetic load 4) if green -> promote for tenant then global ramp
tom: creating ticket RELEASE-5599 with logs and perf delta. assigning to @anita.
anita: will add extra metrics (partner_id, payload_shape) and try a micro-optimization (avoid expensive-normalization path) in patch.
sara: also add a short note in release notes: "Temporarily pinned AcmeCorp to v3.9.8 for embeddings.rerank due to transient p95 regression during canary; fix in progress."
deploy-bot: deploy paused for component=embeddings.rerank status=paused scope=tenant-affecting user=sara
anita: patch ready in branch fix/emb-rerank-acmecorp. requesting canary-only patch deploy to AcmeCorp at 0.5% with synthetic load.
tom: go for synthetic -> `loadtest --tenant AcmeCorp --qps 5 --duration 10m --shape=heavy`
anita: running now. monitoring dashboards and traces. will report in 10m.
sara: excellent. thanks team. closing thread for now, will update when synthetic completes. product-bot: scheduled CS/email update to AcmeCorp."
